repos_data.description: PyTorch implementation of YOLOv3, YOLOv3-SPP, and YOLOv3-tiny for real-time object detection with training, validation, inference, and multi-format export.

The Swiss Army Knife of Offline AI. Chat, see, speak, and generate images on your phone or Mac — GGUF LLMs, vision, Whisper speech-to-text, Stable Diffusion, tool calling, and local-network servers. Runs on your CPU, GPU, or NPU. No account, no API key, zero data leaves your device.
Production-grade C++ edge AI engine for video analytics and on-device VLM across Sophon, Rockchip RKNN, and x86, with visual orchestration, real-time OSD, events, and reproducible benchmarks.

On-device streaming ASR (speech-to-text) for Linux x86_64 + aarch64 — one hardened .so behind Python (PyPI), Node.js (npm), Go (go get), C/C++ (tarball + CMake). AVX2 on servers, NEON on edge. RNN-T + CTC, RTF 0.06–0.08 on x86_64. Same runtime as voxrt-asr-{android,ios}.
